role: Interface of the per-frame render state: struct rs_in (the options, EntityRenderer carried state, render view entity, world time and weather and viewpoint material a frame reads) and struct rs_out (sky, fog, cloud colours, celestial angle, lightmap, projection and modelview, GL fog state), plus the hand camera and Mesa-style fixed-function matrix helpers. Implemented in renderstate.c and checked against netherite.oracle.RenderStateProbe's dump.

structs.name: rs_in
structs.java: GameSettings fields (renderDistanceChunks, viewBobbing, clouds, thirdPersonView, anaglyph, debugCamEnable, fovSetting, gammaSetting), EntityRenderer's carried fields, the render view entity's positions/angles/hurt/death/potion state, World time, rain/thunder strengths, lastLightningBolt, cloudColour, WorldProvider flags and lightBrightnessTable, the biome temperature and sky colour, the partial tick, and the ActiveRenderInfo viewpoint material

structs.name: rs_out
structs.java: the World getters' results, EntityRenderer.fogColorRed/Green/Blue and farPlaneDistance, the lightmap texture's 256 colours, the projection and modelview matrices and camera position setupCameraTransform leaves, and the GL fog state after setupFog(0)

notes: Header only; the hazards (if any) live in renderstate.c, which this record does not review. Callers seen: csrc/play/play.c (renderstate_compute, renderstate_hand_camera) and csrc/engine/raster_hand.c (rs_gl_translate). Pure function of its inputs, no global state declared here. The Java member lists come from the header comment and field comments, not from reading renderstate.c against each Java method.
